工具结果摘要的初始字数上限（档1 base）。留空=按 max_effectiv: Initial char cap for tool-result summaries (tier-1 base). Empty = auto-derive from max_effective_context_window (400K→1500, 600K→2250, 60K→600; mainstream configs unchanged); set to pin explicitly
组间步距衰减字数（per-provider）：空/0=不衰减——所有组 limi: Inter-group step decay chars (per-provider): empty/0 = no decay — all group limits constant, byte-stable rendering, prefix cache fully hit (leaving empty recommended); a value takes precedence (larger = older steps compress sooner)
折叠保留目标线比例（per-provider 缓存经济学）：升档只动历史段尾部、: Fold retention target ratio (per-provider cache economics): tier-up only touches the tail of history (small cache break); folding rewrites the head (big cache break). Providers with steep discount gaps (DeepSeek ≈60x) should go lower, e.g. 0.5 — earlier small tier-ups absorb pressure, folding lands at a lower watermark
轮内保命阀阈值（token）。0=跟随分档窗口 max_effective_co: In-turn safety-valve threshold (tokens). 0 = follow max_effective_context_window; set higher, e.g. 160000 (80% of a 200K window) → between 75%×tier window and this line the turn appends only (cache-optimal); beyond it emergency-fold once back to the planned watermark (75% of tier window, aligned with turn-boundary planning)
超深档（真实档位超过 max_level）的早期轮：工具调用过程整体折叠成一行「: Early turns in ultra-deep tiers (beyond max_level): tool-call processes fold into one line "---- N tool calls folded ----", keeping the final reply and reasoning verbatim — replacing per-call truncated summaries at max_level (187 chars/step). Full processes remain in the archive, recallable.

Action items: text=static text / file=read file / dir=dir listing / cmd=command output / workflow=run workflow / tool=run tool (evaluated & injected each turn). Each action item has an injection mode: merge into content (reminder)=wrapped into the last content (default) / inject into reasoning=as a prefix of the last assistant reasoning_content (pick this for post-steps items meant as environment state for the model to think about).
